resources.string: Every copy goes into your clipboard as always. Add a clipboard here to keep clips apart from it: imported ones, or clips for one project. The ▾ beside the clipboard panel\'s title switches between them, and Move to clipboard on a held clip or on picked clips puts clips into one. Clips in a clipboard you added are kept until you delete them, like pinned clips.
A place of its own for clips, opened from the ▾ in the clipboard panel
You have as many clipboards as the panel can list
Its clips are deleted with it, pinned ones too. Move any you want to keep into another clipboard first.
The panel\'s search finds clips in all your clipboards, not only the open one

On, a search in the clipboard panel and its filters look through every clipboard at once, and each clip from another clipboard says which one it is in. Off, they look only in the clipboard that is open. On by default.
The clipboard history in a HeliBoard, LeanType, FUTO, FlorisBoard or CleverKeys backup, a config file, or a text file with one clip a line, kept apart from your own clips
Nothing to import: the file had no clips this app can read, or you have as many clipboards as the panel can list
